description: Sample terrain elevation. Provide `points` (a bare list of coordinates) for point elevation, or `encoded_polyline` (optionally with `resample_distance_m`) for an along-route profile — not both. Returns one sample per point/resampled point in order; `elevation_m` is null wherever the engine's DEM tile set has no coverage at that point (never a guess). The `encoded_polyline` form also returns each sample's resampled lat/lon and cumulative `range_km` from the start.

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

encoded_polyline.description:
A route as a Google encoded polyline with six digits of precision.
Provide this or `points`, not both.

points.description: Points to sample. Provide this or `encoded_polyline`, not both.

resample_distance_m.description:
Resamples `encoded_polyline` at this spacing in metres before
sampling height (ignored for `points`).

name: elevation

ElevationSample.description:
One elevation sample: `elevation_m` and, when the request set
`encoded_polyline`, the resampled point and its cumulative distance
from the start.

elevation_m.description:
Elevation in metres, or `null` when the engine has no DEM tile
coverage at this point — Valhalla's own honest value, never a
guess.

lat.description: Latitude of the (possibly resampled) point, when known.

lon.description: Longitude of the (possibly resampled) point, when known.

range_km.description:
Cumulative distance from the first point in kilometres, present
only for the `encoded_polyline` form.

samples.description:
One sample per input point (or per resampled shape point, in the
`encoded_polyline` form), in order.
